positions.title: Technical Lead: Web Applications / Software Developer
positions.description:
Provide leadership and direction to my team, while managing, and maintaining multiple projects.
Promote the use of software engineering best practices.
Research and develop new technology for more efficient & effective processes.
Internal and external infrastructure design, setup and maintenance of systems.

positions.title: Productivity Consultant: Advanced Product Support
positions.description:
Provide expert technical support in a call center environment. 
Support major "off-the-shelf" software, and Tier 1 support.
Work on major development projects that include visual basic code, Javascirpt, and HTML.
Provide mobile support for Blackberry, Windows Mobile & iPhone. 
Provide documentation for each solution provided to clients.
Provide code based internal solutions including Windows, Intranet and data systems development. 
Tier 1 support includes Windows 2003 server Account lockouts & Password resets 
Support over 20 "off-the-shelf" products
